title: Which of our sites follow TI onto the shared tier, and which stay dedicated
description:
Outcome: A decision record for Ryan with a recommended order once TI is done: Pilobolus (pre-production, a blog without sections) second; then the small product and marketing sites that already fit the preset; DataParade (served under a host site's path) after base-path support on the shared stack. Stay dedicated for now (owner decision 13): Shipped (product-shaped hooks), Anth.us (production; never touched without instruction), Machines on Machines (design reference, most active newsroom). Distinctive Mark: dedicated until its staged upgrade is done (its own board), then decide. Each move reuses the TI runbook.

Touches (verified at origin/develop 23fabe1d): docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md, existing PPY-259a3f (plan moving our dedicated sites).

Acceptance (Gherkin feature file: none (decision record)):
Scenario: Every site has a stated tier
    Given the list of our Papyrus sites
    When the decision is recorded
    Then each site is shared-next, shared-later or dedicated, with a reason

Dependencies: blocked by PPY-16f13a. Blocks nothing in this plan yet. (Also recorded as kbs dependencies.)
Implements or extends: PPY-259a3f.

Testing: None.
Rollout: Decision only.
Risk and mitigation: Low.

Releasable on its own: not applicable (decision).
DynamoDB index: none.
